sections.title: Water & Wastewater
sections.summary: Groundwater dependence and wet-weather wastewater constraints shape the public-capital and environmental discussion.

sections.title: Public Capital
sections.summary: Pinehaven has already prioritized roads, water, public safety and community facilities through its fictional sales-tax program.

facts.label: SPLOST

sections.title: Agriculture
sections.summary: Row crops, poultry and irrigated acreage are central to Pinehaven's fictional economy and water context.

sections.confirmation: Farmers, extension, water professionals and agriculture agencies.
